detail: Forecast values require a plan. Start a 14-day free trial at https://fxmacrodata.com/subscribe. The sources that cover this indicator are listed in this response and at https://api.fxmacrodata.com/v1/predictions/coverage/usd, which needs no key.

verified_history.cadence: Sparse: roughly three FOMC meetings per year. For a deeper FOMC consensus series use policy_rate_midpoint.

reason_text.compiled_consensus: No source publishes this kind of forecast for this currency and indicator. This is a property of the data, not of your plan: no subscription adds it.

availability.plan_note: Forecast values require a plan. Which publishers cover this pair does not: the source list above is set by the publisher and is the same on every plan, so a subscription unlocks the numbers, not an extra source.

official_forecasts.note: Official forecasts and surveys in their own periods and units (quarterly averages, annual rates, survey horizons) are served in the official_forecasts array of this response, every vintage with its publication date. They are not merged into data because their period basis differs from the monthly announcement's.
